zh.title: RwandAir 規劃本財年再接收四架 A330-200　瞄準歐洲與遠東新航點
zh.summary: RwandAir 商務長表示，四架 A330-200 預計在本財年加入，將支援歐洲與遠東航網擴張。
body: RwandAir 商務長 Reuben Mbonye 接受 AeroTime 訪問時表示，公司預計在本財年再接收四架 Airbus A330-200。這批飛機是在 8 月 24 日已接收一架 A330-200 之後的後續擴充。
Mbonye 表示，新增廣體機將用於開闢歐洲與遠東的新航點；具體城市與開航日期尚未公布。這項規劃仍取決於飛機交付與營運準備。
RwandAir 今年 5 月曾在官方公告中預告，將於第四季增加一架 A330-200，以加強長程航線能力。最新訪談顯示，公司正進一步擴大廣體機隊計畫。

en.title: RwandAir plans four more A330-200s this financial year for Europe and Far East growth
en.summary: Chief commercial officer Reuben Mbonye says four A330-200s are expected to join during the financial year to support expansion into Europe and the Far East.
body: RwandAir chief commercial officer Reuben Mbonye told AeroTime that the airline expects four additional Airbus A330-200s during the current financial year. The plan follows the arrival of another A330-200 on August 24.

Mbonye said the extra widebodies would support new destinations in Europe and the Far East. Specific cities and launch dates have not been announced, and the plan remains dependent on aircraft deliveries and operational readiness.
In a May update, RwandAir had already said an A330-200 was expected in the fourth quarter to strengthen long-haul operations. The latest interview signals a broader widebody expansion.

facts.claim: RwandAir's chief commercial officer said four additional A330-200s were expected during the current financial year.
The planned aircraft would support new destinations in Europe and the Far East, with no specific cities or dates yet announced.
RwandAir had previously announced an expected fourth-quarter A330-200 addition for long-haul operations.
